info.title: sunrise-sunset.org
info.description: A free, keyless solar-event service. `twilightToday` returns sunrise, sunset and all three twilight boundaries — civil, nautical and ASTRONOMICAL — for a coordinate pair. Astronomical dusk is when the sky is actually dark; sunset is not. Times are UTC. NOTE the longitude parameter is spelled `lng`, not `lon`.

get.summary: Sunrise, sunset and the civil/nautical/astronomical twilight boundaries for today
get.description: Returns `{results: {...}, status: 'OK'}`. `results` carries `sunrise`, `sunset`, `solar_noon`, `day_length` (seconds), and `civil_`, `nautical_` and `astronomical_twilight_begin`/`_end`, all UTC ISO-8601 when `formatted=0`. The begin values are THIS MORNING and the end values are TONIGHT. A place with no astronomical night — a high latitude in summer — comes back as `1970-01-01T00:00:00+00:00`, which is the service saying 'this event does not occur here today', not an error.

parameters.name: formatted
parameters.description: Always `0` — 0 gives ISO-8601 UTC, 1 gives unparseable prose.
